content.short: Aerodrome is the central liquidity hub and primary decentralized exchange for the Base network, using a ve(3,3) model.
content.description: Aerodrome Finance is the central liquidity hub and primary decentralized exchange (DEX) for the Base network, Coinbase's Layer-2. It utilizes a ve(3,3) vote-lock governance system where users lock AERO tokens to receive veAERO NFTs, granting them voting power over emissions. This model aligns the interests of traders, liquidity providers, and governors to create a sustainable growth flywheel. The protocol distributes 100% of fees and bribes to voters who direct emissions to specific pools, ensuring deep liquidity and low-slippage swaps for the entire Base DeFi ecosystem and users.
